summary: A restart that automatic Claude channel recovery requests is carried out in the same reconcile pass, as a changed declaration's is, instead of waiting for the next pass, which took minutes on a loaded daemon

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Recovery decides and records its restart request exactly as before; the ordinary restart path, with all its checks at the stop, now runs right after it in the same evaluation. A park is recorded and stops its seat at the next evaluation, as before.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the old timing: a recovery restart is carried out in the reconcile pass after the one that requested it.
